children: Palantir Technologies and Nvidia are collaborating to bring sovereign artificial intelligence to critical supply chains, starting with Nvidia's own operations.

The two tech conglomerates said they will create an AI stack that brings Nvidia Nemotron open models into Palantir's foundry and AI platform. The goal is to create more supply-chain visibility, identify constraints and guide faster decisions, they said.
Beyond Nvidia, organizations across industries can use the AI stack to optimize their own supply chains, the companies added.

Customers can create their own supply-chain AI stack by post-training Nvidia Nemotron with their own data using Palantir's platforms. The software provides optimizations and scenario planning to show teams different constraints and possibilities, the companies said.
Nvidia said its Nemotron models then recommend actions, explain tradeoffs and flag emerging risks, while human supply-chain experts retain control of final decisions.

Each usage of the platform strengthens the system because feedback is used to support model improvement, the companies said. Nvidia's deployment of the program is also meant to help improve it for other businesses and government groups, they added.
Palantir said it plans to showcase the AI stack at its conference AIPcon 11 on Thursday.
